name: ocr-bench-rubenstein-judge-kimi-k25
description: An OCR benchmarking dataset measuring optical character recognition/transcription performance on scanned/text images. It provides image–text pairs intended to evaluate text detection and recognition systems under varied conditions. The dataset is hosted on Hugging Face and is intended for researchers benchmarking OCR accuracy and robustness.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used primarily by OCR researchers and practitioners; not a widely adopted community standard.
